scope: Controlled guest-capacity comparison and checked module/compactor allocations. These are one-test subsets, not complete suites. No host OOM was induced.
reproduction: Build with scripts/full-lean/build.mjs --stage wasm64 --jobs 2 --link-opt -O1 --lean-allocator mimalloc --memory64 2 --max-memory-gb 4 --pthread-pool 8; compare native memory64 1 / max-memory-gb 8. Prepare separate frozen toolchains and unchanged suites, filter ^elab/instances\.lean$. All heavy operations use run-bounded.mjs.
comparison: v30 and v31 share identical Wasm; v31 adjusts the imported memory maximum and glue heap limit to 4 GiB. v33 relinks the same checked Lean archives as v32 for native memory64 and 8 GiB. Full commands and archive hashes are in each snapshot relink.json.
findings: Unchecked module-buffer allocation can write to address zero in WebAssembly. The separate compactor has unchecked initial/growth allocations too.
At 4 GiB the checked loader reports INTERNAL PANIC: out of memory instead of the misleading _private import failure. This remains a failed upstream test.
The unchanged test passes with native memory64 and an 8 GiB guest both before and after the checks.
The above results do not establish that all other low-memory failure paths or all engines are correct.
